context: Tests whether the agent structures specs correctly with RSpec.describe using constant paths, proper method describe naming, context vs describe usage, and valid shared examples.

checklist.name: describe '#method' naming
checklist.description: Uses `describe '#parseable?'` and `describe '#word_count'` format for the two instance methods

checklist.name: context not used for method grouping
checklist.description: Does NOT use `context 'parseable?' do` or `context 'word_count' do` — context is used for scenario variations, describe for method grouping

checklist.name: context 'when' or 'with' naming
checklist.description: All context blocks use `context 'when ...'` or `context 'with ...'` phrasing

checklist.name: Shared examples defined
checklist.description: Defines shared examples in a separate file under `spec/support/shared_examples/` (not inline in the spec)

checklist.name: Shared examples included correctly
checklist.description: Includes shared examples with `include_examples` or `it_behaves_like` — and the shared example name matches what's defined

checklist.name: Frozen string literal
checklist.description: Both spec files start with `# frozen_string_literal: true`

checklist.name: No 'and' in descriptions
checklist.description: No `it` or `specify` description contains the word 'and'

checklist.name: Model spec type chosen
checklist.description: Uses model specs (not request or system specs) for this pure domain logic

checklist.name: Observed RED output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed RED output`

checklist.name: Observed GREEN output label
checklist.description: TDD proof uses the literal label `Observed GREEN output`

checklist.name: Resource loading documented
checklist.description: answer.md includes a resource loading section
